verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence is a community report of an employee exercising roughly $20k of options through Carta, with Carta initiating the bank-transfer payment. That shows an online exercise and payment flow exists, but the transfer failed and the exercise was cancelled, so the share issuance outcome is never demonstrated. The FMV API only calculates tax implications of exercising, which is adjacent and earns no credit. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the employee exercise workflow, evidence that payment is processed reliably, documented share issuance after exercise, and confirmation that no paper forms are needed.
